content.text:
The campaign is finished and submitted. The best composition I measured is **index 8 (Ag 0.55 / Sb 0.45), with an EQE of 0.893%**.

The budget allowed only 3 EQE measurements, all now used. I aimed them at the middle of the composition line because the phase database lists AgSbO₃ there, at a 1:1 Ag:Sb ratio. AgSbO₃ absorbs visible light, so it should respond at the 2.7 eV illumination.

| Index | Ag fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 11 | 0.43 | 0.405 |
| 9 | 0.51 | 0.867 |
| 8 | 0.55 | 0.893 |

EQE drops steeply toward the Sb-rich side. I didn't measure any composition more Ag-rich than index 8. EQE was still rising from index 9 to index 8, so the true best may be slightly more Ag-rich, around index 7 (Ag 0.59). I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so which phases are actually in the films wasn't confirmed.
